meta.name: transformer-lens-interpretability
meta.description: Provides guidance for mechanistic interpretability research using TransformerLens to inspect and manipulate transformer internals via HookPoints and activation caching. Use when reverse-engineering model algorithms, studying attention patterns, or performing activation patching experiments.

copy.tagline: 用 HookPoints 探查和操控 Transformer 内部机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 TransformerLens 做机械可解释性研究
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and manipulate transformer internals via HookPoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing mechanistic interpretability research with TransformerLens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 TransformerLens 库来分析和操控 GPT 风格语言模型的内部机制，例如缓存激活值、进行激活修补实验、研究注意力模式或识别电路。
howto.when: 当你需要逆向工程模型算法、研究注意力模式或执行激活修补实验时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TransformerLens 对 GPT-2 做激活修补实验。
say.note: Claude 会指导你定义干净/损坏提示、缓存激活并修补。

say.text: 如何用 TransformerLens 检测 GPT-2 中的归纳头？
say.note: Claude 会提供检测归纳头的代码步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using the TransformerLens library to inspect and manipulate the internals of GPT-style language models, such as caching activations, performing activation patching experiments, studying attention patterns, or identifying circuits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to reverse-engineer model algorithms, study attention patterns, or perform activation patching experiments.

say_en.text: Help me run an activation patching experiment on GPT-2 using TransformerLens.
How to detect induction heads in GPT-2 with TransformerLens?
say_en.note: Claude will provide code steps for induction head detection.
